name: aidepilot
description: A modern, lightweight API testing client — like Postman, but faster and cleaner

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron electron/main.js"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=backend
